headline: Approved solar parking canopy purchase and 2026-2027 strategic direction
summary: The commission approved minutes from a prior meeting, heard financial reports for June FY26 and July FY27, and discussed a proposed solar canopy project during an executive session. After returning from executive session, the commission approved the capital purchase of a solar parking canopy at 585 Pine Street and approved the 2026-2027 strategic direction.
decisions: Found that premature public knowledge of contract negotiations for a solar canopy project would place the Commission at a disadvantage, 5-0
Entered executive session to discuss contract negotiations for the proposed solar canopy, 5-0
Approved BED's capital purchase of a solar parking canopy for 585 Pine Street, funded from available bond proceeds, 5-0
Approved the 2026-2027 Strategic Direction as presented, 5-0

plain_text:
1 
 
 
 
DRAFT 
MINUTES OF REGULAR MEETING 
BURLINGTON ELECTRIC COMMISSION 
 
Wednesday, September 9, 2026 
                  
The regular meeting of the Burlington Electric Commission was convened at 5:03 p.m. on 
Wednesday, September 9, 2026, at Burlington Electric Department, 585 Pine Street, Burlington, 
Vermont, and on Microsoft Teams. 
 
Attendance 
 Channel 17 was present to record this meeting. 
 Commissioners Lara Bonn, Paul Dawson, Ali Kenney, and Andy Vota were present at 585 
Pine Street.  
 Commissioner Brian Williams was present via Microsoft Teams.  
 Staff members Paul Alexander, Dan Edson, Mike Kanarick, Munir Kasti, Katie Morris, Darren 
Springer, and Emily Stebbins-Wheelock were present at 585 Pine Street. 
 Staff members Seth Clifford and James Gibbons was present via Microsoft Teams.  
 Public members Leendert Huisman and Peter Macausland were present at 585 Pine Street. 
 Public member Pike Porter was present via Microsoft Teams.  
 
1. Agenda 
There were no changes to the agenda.  
 
2. Meeting Minutes 
Commissioner Dawson moved to accept the July 8, 2026 minutes as presented; Commissioner Vota 
seconded the motion. Vote: 5 ayes 0 nays.  
 
3. Public Forum 
Leendert Huisman addressed the commission regarding the relationship between BED, the 
commission, and McNeil generating station.  
 
Peter Macausland addressed the commission  
 
4. Monthly Impact Minute 
General Manager Darren Springer introduced Dan Edson, the Department’s new Manager of Energy 
Services.  
 
Dan Edson addressed the commission
2 
 
 
 
5. Commissioners’ Corner 
There were no topics discussed.  
 
6. GM Update 
General Manager Darren Springer  
 
7. Financials: Preliminary June FY26 
Emily Stebbins-Wheelock presented the preliminary June FY26 financial results.  
 
8. Financials: July FY27 
Emily Stebbins-Wheelock, CFO and Manager of Strategy & Innovation, presented July 2026 ϐinancial 
results. 
 
9. Solar Canopy Executive Session 
General Manager Darren Springer and James Gibbons, Director of Policy and Planning, presented 
information about a proposed solar canopy project at 585 Pine Street.  
 
Commissioner Vota made a motion that the Commission find that premature general public 
knowledge of contract negotiations related to the Commission and BED’s negotiating position and 
strategy for a proposed solar canopy, to be located at 585 Pine Street, would clearly place the 
Commission and BED at a substantial disadvantage in those negotiations. Commissioner Bonn 
seconded the motion. Vote: 5 ayes 0 nays. 
 
Based on that finding, Commissioner Bonn made a motion that the Commission enter executive 
session, with BED staff present, pursuant to 1 V.S.A. § 313(a)(1)(A) to discuss ongoing contract 
negotiations regarding a proposed solar canopy to be located at 585 Pine Street. Commissioner 
Dawson seconded the motion. Vote: 5 ayes 0 nays. The Burlington Electric commission entered 
executive session at 5:59 p.m. 
 
Commissioner Vota made a motion to exit executive session; Commissioner Dawson seconded. 
Vote: 5 ayes 0 nays. The Burlington Electric commission exited executive session at 6:33 p.m.  
 
10. Solar Canopy Discussion & Vote 
Commissioner Bonn made a motion that the Commission approve BED’s capital purchase of a solar 
parking canopy for 585 Pine Street, to be funded from available bond proceeds, as presented at 
tonight’s meeting. Commissioner Vota seconded the motion. Vote: 5 ayes 0 nays.  
 
11. 2026-2027 Strategic Direction 
General Manager Darren Springer presented changes to the proposed 2026-2027 strategic 
direction.
3 
 
 
 
 
Commissioner Vota made a motion that the commission approve the 2026-2027 Strategic Direction 
as presented at tonight’s meeting. Commissioner Dawson seconded the motion. Vote: 5 aye 0 nay.  
 
12. Commissioners’ Check-In 
No topics were discussed.  
 
Adjourn  
Commissioner Williams made a motion to adjourn; the motion was seconded by Commissioner 
Bonn. Vote: 5 ayes 0 nays. 
 
The meeting of the Burlington Electric Commission adjourned at 6:47 p.m. 
 
Microsoft Teams transcript used to draft minutes prepared by Katie Morris and edited by Emily 
Stebbins-Wheelock, CFO and Manager of Strategy & Innovation.
